description_en: Queries the list of stability rules. The system monitors the stability of the server-side InitFaceVerify operation and API integration operations. If a threshold is triggered, the system sends an alert
description_zh: 查询稳定性规则列表：通过对服务端初始化InitFaceVerify接口和API集成接口稳定性的监控规则，如果触发阈值，系统支持进行告警
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth query-control-strategy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --product-type ANT_CLOUD_AUTH --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryControlStrategy

parameters.help_en: The product type. Currently, only ANT_CLOUD_AUTH (financial-grade ID Verification) is supported. All other product types have been discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型，目前仅支持ANT_CLOUD_AUTH（金融级实人），其他均退市
parameters.name: product_type

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 返回码：200为成功，其他为失败

ApiName.description_en: The API name, which is the same as the ProductCode of the verification operation

BizType.description_en:
The rule configuration type. Valid values:

QPS: QPS greater than
SUCCESS_RATE_5_MIN: success rate in the last 5 minutes less than
RESP_TIME_5_MIN: average response time in the last 5 minutes greater than
AMOUNT_RISE: call volume increase compared to the previous period greater than
AMOUNT_FALL: call volume decrease compared to the previous period less than
PASSED_RATE_1_HOUR: verification consistency rate in the last hour less than
PARAM_ERROR_RATE_1_HOUR: parameter error rate in the last hour greater than
BizType.description_zh:
规则配置类型：
QPS：QPS大于
SUCCESS_RATE_5_MIN：近5分钟成功率小于
RESP_TIME_5_MIN：近5分钟平均响应时间大于
AMOUNT_RISE：调用量环比增长大于
AMOUNT_FALL：调用量环比降低小于
PASSED_RATE_1_HOUR：近1小时核验一致率小于
PARAM_ERROR_RATE_1_HOUR：近1小时参数错误率大于

Status.description_en:
The status. Valid values:

disabled: Disabled.
normal: Enabled
Status.description_zh:
状态：
disabled：禁用
normal：启用

Threshold.description_en: The alert threshold for configure alerting of the rule
